description: The Google ADK weather agent with SSE streaming enabled, so both model turns stream.
notes: google-adk 2.14.0. The runner sets GOOGLE_API_KEY, so the Gemini client uses the API-key path and does not probe the metadata server. Gemini.base_url is the mock. Cloud Trace export is started only by the ADK CLI server, which this scenario does not run. ADK_EXPERIMENTAL_TELEMETRY is false. ADK_TELEMETRY_SCHEMA_VERSION_OPT_IN is 1. ADK_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT_IN_SPANS is true. RunConfig.streaming_mode is SSE. The mock waits 120 ms before the first chunk and splits text into 4 chunks. The spans have no timing attribute. The span tree matches agent-tool. The streamed final response is marked partial false. Token counts are the scripted inclusive numbers, input 40 output 12 then input 58 output 16. Event ids come from set_id_provider, a counter of capture-N. The session id is session-1 and the user id is user-1.

message.text: It is 18 °C and sunny in Paris.
